tableDescription: POC 阶段指标目录，登记业务指标口径、来源与负责人，支撑溯源

columnDescriptions.source_asset: 来源资产如 BI 报表或文档
columnDescriptions.source_field_hint: 原始字段或计算公式线索
columnDescriptions.formula: 指标计算公式，原子指标可空
columnDescriptions.description: 指标业务口径与适用范围说明
columnDescriptions.pending_confirmation: 待确认问题或字段疑点

tableDescription: Daily ad revenue fact table by ad position and country for FineVis monetization scenarios.

columnDescriptions.dt: Statistics date at daily granularity, Beijing time natural day.
columnDescriptions.position_name: Ad slot name such as splash, weather home, or feed.
columnDescriptions.country: Country or region distinguishing domestic versus international ad business.
columnDescriptions.ad_revenue: Ad revenue amount in yuan, core monetization KPI.
columnDescriptions.ad_impressions: Total ad impression count used for eCPM calculation.
columnDescriptions.ad_dau: Monetized daily active users exposed to ads.
columnDescriptions.arpu_check: ARPU verification value in yuan per user for evaluation only.
columnDescriptions.ecpm_check: eCPM verification value in yuan per thousand impressions for evaluation.
columnDescriptions.seed_scenario: Synthetic data scenario tag marking special generation cases.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first created.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent record modification.
